fields.label: Registry Host
fields.description: Registry the images are pulled from, e.g. 'ghcr.io' (GitHub) or 'docker.io' (Docker Hub). Prefixed onto each Engine Image's path.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Login user. Blank (with a blank token) = anonymous pulls only — fine for public images.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Access token or password (encrypted). GHCR needs a PAT with read:packages.
